decision.reason: The subject and the change are clear. [ev-fa371709f05a] says the kubeconfig is no longer written to the CNI net directory. [ev-7ef42ff9e677] explains that the istio-cni node agent used to build a kubeconfig from its own token and write it next to the CNI config, and that the CNI plugin read it to call the API server. [ev-191d17c9702d] adds that `CNI_NET_DIR` now does nothing. That points to istio-cni installs as the exposed environments, but the consequence is not stated. The shown issue is only a feature request, and its list of options is cut off in [ev-c7426fc8e54f], so it does not say which option was built or how the plugin now gets credentials. Nothing shown says whether an operator who does nothing sees no impact, an upgrade-skew break between old plugin binaries and the new agent, or broken tooling that read the file. The description of PR 52323 or an upgrade note stating the impact is needed.
